title: [Bring the other sources in...
content_text:
[Bring the other sources in under Garmin as the anchor — phone, Mac, WeRead, and anything else down the road.]
其他数据源都并入埋，以佳明手环做锚——手机、Mac、微信读书，以后再有乜都照加。
[That way you can tell what I was doing and when, and actually reconstruct my day — even listening to audiobooks while I'm at work.]
咁样就可以知道我几点喺度做紧乜，清楚还原我成日嘅行为——就算係返工嗰阵听电子书都还原到。
[Get as close to that as you can, and optimize the relevant skills.]
尽量做到最贴近呢个效果，顺手将相关嘅 skill 优化埋。
[The WeRead data should be pulled fresh each time the updated daily report job runs — don't read the stale files.]
微信读书嘅数据，每次嗰个升级咗嘅日更 job 跑嗰阵都要拉最新嘅——唔好净係读旧文件。
